content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The 15 posts are distributed across seven academic areas as follows:

rows.post_name: Academic Associate - Operations & Supply Chain Management

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Master's Degree / MBA / 2-year Post Graduate Diploma in a relevant or allied discipline from a recognized University/Institution. Minimum 60% marks throughout academic years, or equivalent CGPA, is required. Candidates pursuing or having completed a Ph.D. in Management or a relevant/allied discipline may also be considered, subject to fulfilment of prescribed requirements. Desirable: minimum one year of relevant experience. Preferable: experience as an Academic Associate at a management institute ranked among the top 50 in the latest NIRF rankings. Strong communication, interpersonal, and coordination skills. Proficiency in MS Office, internet applications, and ERP systems. Good command over written and spoken English and Hindi. Ability to multitask, work under timelines, and maintain confidentiality. Adaptability and flexibility during examinations and institutional events. Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit: 32 years as on the last date of application. The age limit can be extended up to 35 years for Ph.D. holders or candidates with relevant experience. Age relaxation is applicable to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates as per Central Government rules, subject to submission of the prescribed certificate(s). The crucial date for determining age is the closing date for receipt of applications. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Salary/Stipend Structure 2026
IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Assist in scheduling classes, examinations, and academic activities. Prepare and circulate timetables, notices, and official communications. Maintain academic records, attendance, files, and documentation. Support faculty in course administration, grading support, and academic coordination. Coordinate meetings, workshops, seminars, and guest lectures. Assist in examination processes, invigilation, and handling of examination materials. Address routine student queries related to academics and examinations. Support organization of institutional events and academic programmes. Perform additional duties assigned by the Institute.

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process may include one or more of the following stages, as decided by the Competent Authority based on the requirements of the post and the number of applications received: Written Test Skill/Competency Test Personal Interview Any other mode of assessment deemed appropriate by the Institute The assessment may evaluate a candidate's domain knowledge, aptitude, general ability, and suitability for the position. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting; the Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for the further recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be required to produce original documents for verification at the time of final selection, including: Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Master's Degree/MBA/PG Diploma/Ph.D., as applicable) Proof of date of birth (for age verification) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD), if applicable, for age relaxation Experience certificates, if claiming work experience A valid and active email ID, as all communication will be sent exclusively via email

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies across seven academic areas: Analytics & Decision Science, Operations & Supply Chain Management, Sustainability Management, OBHR Management, Marketing, Finance Economics & Strategy, and Public Policy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 13 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for IIM Mumbai Academic Associate posts?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree, MBA, or a 2-year Post Graduate Diploma in a relevant or allied discipline with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent CGPA is required. Ph.D. candidates in a relevant discipline may also be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 32 years, extendable up to 35 years for Ph.D. holders or candidates with relevant experience. Age relaxation applies to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or stipend for IIM Mumbai Academic Associates?
faq.answer: Post-Graduates receive ₹45,000 to ₹55,000 per month, while Ph.D. degree holders receive ₹60,000 to ₹70,000 per month, along with housing, travelling, and mobile allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for IIM Mumbai Academic Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the official notification. Candidates should check the online application portal for any fee details at the time of applying.
